recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-39431 correction in the active DeviceMetric StructureDefinition without changing the allowed coding representation; any broader unit terminology policy changes should be handled by their own DEV decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-39431 was Published with a Persuasive R5 resolution to change DeviceMetric.unit from the broad Device Metric and Component Types value set to all of UCUM with preferred strength.
initial_application: Commit 471e546700387be46eaef1cbd2218cdb9275706f from HL7/fhir#2820 changed the DeviceMetric.unit valueSet from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/devicemetric-type to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/ucum-units. That initial application left adjacent binding metadata saying IEEE 11073-10101 and the comment saying RTMMS was preferred; later FHIR-51404 formatting cleanup linked the names but retained the preference wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes devicemetric=DeviceMetric, so source/devicemetric/structuredefinition-DeviceMetric.xml is in current build scope. Earlier unit trackers FHIR-7141 and FHIR-7596 support the UCUM preference history, while later FHIR-50161 kept DeviceMetric.unit as CodeableConcept so both UCUM and MDC codings can still be represented. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence decision that conflicts with this interpretation.
reconciliation: Changed only source/devicemetric/structuredefinition-DeviceMetric.xml: removed the stale RTMMS preference from the DeviceMetric.unit comment and changed the binding description from IEEE 11073-10101 to Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM), while keeping the preferred UCUM value set and CodeableConcept type.
source_changes: source/devicemetric/structuredefinition-DeviceMetric.xml: DeviceMetric.unit comment now says UCUM or RTMMS can be used without stating that RTMMS is preferred.
source/devicemetric/structuredefinition-DeviceMetric.xml: DeviceMetric.unit binding description now identifies Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM) instead of IEEE 11073-10101.

related_jiras.note: Historical Published DeviceMetric unit issue resolved to change the unit binding from RTM/required to UCUM/LOINC/preferred.
Historical No Change issue records the same UCUM preference concern as already addressed by the prior DeviceMetric unit change family.
Later No Change decision kept DeviceMetric.unit as CodeableConcept so a unit can be represented in both UCUM and MDC; it does not reverse the UCUM preferred binding.
Later Applied formatting cleanup touched the DeviceMetric.unit comment but did not make or reverse a terminology preference decision.
